text: You will investigate the effect of solution E on cucumber.
• Remove the plastic film covering the section of cucumber.
• Cut a slice of the tissue from one end of the cucumber and discard.
• Cut one thin slice, no more than 2mm in thickness, from the freshly cut end of the
section of cucumber. Place the slice onto a clean white tile.
• Remove the centre from the slice as shown in Fig. 2.1.
• Cut the slice in half as shown in Fig. 2.2.
• Use the forceps to place one piece of cucumber in each Petri dish.
• Label one Petri dish E and the other W.
• Cover the piece of cucumber in Petri dish E with solution E.
• Cover the piece of cucumber in Petri dish W with water.
• Leave the pieces of cucumber in solution E and water for 10 minutes.
While you are waiting continue with part (a) and Question 3.
